$comment: v0.1.6 reference recipe demonstrating the LIST view shape (per Ch 30) + the anti-join verb (per Ch 29 Settled #14). Lists concepts that have NO valid evidence junction attached - the canonical compliance-gap query. CORRECTED 2026-08-21 (Challenge 45): the previous version queried subject_id/predicate_id, which are crosswalk-edge fields that evidence junction notes do not carry, against predicate ':hasEvidence', which nothing emits. It therefore matched nothing and the gap list was silently wrong. Junction notes carry subject/subject_curie/predicate/object per spec tier1 junction_note_frontmatter. Matching is by subject_curie (stable identity), never by wikilink text, so renaming a control note does not detach its evidence. output.target is tier2 because this query is an anti-join: Bases filters among notes that exist and cannot emit a row for an absent relationship. The authoritative implementation is conceptsWithoutValidEvidence() in src/tier2/evidence-coverage.ts.

query.title: Orphan controls (no evidence linked)
query.description: Concepts with zero VALID evidence junctions. Valid means: predicate is exactly has_evidence, the junction resolves to the concept by subject_curie, status is approved, coverage is full or partial, and it is neither expired nor stale. Anti-join semantics: KEEP concept IF NOT EXISTS a valid junction.

view.empty_label: (Every concept has valid evidence - no gaps)
